scripts.build:electron: pnpm run build && ncp electron dist && electron-packager dist Vue3FrontDemo --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --icon=public/vite.svg
scripts.create:cordova: pnpm run build && ncp dist cordova/www && cd cordova && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path platforms/android) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force platforms/android }" && cordova platform add android && ncp gradle platforms/android/gradle && ncp gradlew platforms/android
scripts.prepare:cordova: pnpm run build && ncp dist cordova/www && cd cordova && cordova prepare android
scripts.build:cordova: pnpm run prepare:cordova && cd cordova/platforms/android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease && ncp app/build/outputs/apk/release/ ../../../release/cordova/
